hook.line: Please don't post another blog post until you watch this.
hook.visual: Top half: Search Console screen under a green 'Why your blogs don't rank in AI' card. Bottom half: man in red headphones gesturing hard. Highlighted caption on the seam.

beats.what: Warning not to post another blog, green title card over a Search Console screenshot
Shows 'Crawled - currently not indexed' with 282 affected pages as the proof of the problem
Names the cause: optimizing for one keyword instead of fan-out queries
Screen switches to a keyword tool's fan-out query page with 'seo content' typed in
Zoom on the results table of fan-out queries (22 found)
Mind-map diagram: one prompt branching into the AI's hidden follow-up questions
Diagram converges the branches into a 'best answer possible' box
Pivot to his free seven-lesson course; lesson list shown on screen
Points to the 'learn more' button below

why_it_works: Direct 'stop before you post' callout targets anyone who blogs and implies they are wasting effort right now
Proof on screen early (282 not-indexed pages in his own Search Console) makes the problem concrete before the fix
Hand-drawn style mind map of one prompt fanning into sub-questions explains an invisible AI process visually
Upper half always shows a screen while the lower half keeps the face, so there is no dead visual even with zero cuts
weaknesses: 158 s in one take with no cuts; the middle explanation (65-125 s) repeats the definition
Ends as a course pitch; the 'how to write it' payoff is held back behind the link
Quiet mix (-26.0 LUFS) and small on-screen UI text that is hard to read on a phone
for_robert: Use the top-screen, bottom-face split with the caption on the seam, and draw the hidden process as a simple branching diagram Fred can swim along; but cut it well under 158 s.
